title: Antoni Augustyn Deboli → King Stanisław August, cipher despatches from St Petersburg, 1783
correspondents: Antoni Augustyn Deboli (Polish envoy at St Petersburg) → Stanisław August
status: AGAD inventory: "Korespondencja polityczna tajna (pismo cyfrowe) ... Listy zapisane szyfrem"; no decipherment noted. Keys in the same fonds: ZbPop 444 "Cyfra polska posłana do Petersburga Deboliemu" 8 III 1783; 451 "Chiffre François Nouveau envoyé a Monsieur Deboli" 1780; 453-454 the Cabinet's numbered keys 1772-1795 (not seen online). Not on DECODE (list dump searched); not in repo (known.py Deboli, Popiel: no hits). No scan album found on agadd2 for this signature; may be on szukajwarchiwach (blocked).
why: The Polish envoy's secret reports from Catherine II's court to the King; the ciphered parts carry what he would not put in the open despatch.
language: Polish/French (unknown which; the clear despatches of the same days are in Polish)
prior_art: open as far as checked: Zielińska & Danilczyk print the Deboli correspondence only for 1780, 1781, 1782 (IH PAN, 2015-2017+); later years unedited, Rolnik 2025 says the Great Sejm reports remain in manuscript. A contemporary decipherment may survive in the King's cabinet copies (cf. ZbPop 320, deciphered register for 1774-77) (checked 26 Oct 2026: web search, Zielińska & Danilczyk IH PAN edition series, known.py)
